description: MiaAI-Lab native TensorFold at db28187 on two Sparks, with the creator's pinned int4-autoround checkpoint. Sixteen concurrent streams share the engine's dynamic FP8 KV pool; 1,048,576-token window with YaRN factor four, MTP depth fifteen, RoCE all-gather, image/video helper on rank zero. FP8 KV is lossy; draft verification does not imply equivalence to BF16 KV. Memory peak is an estimate for one full-window request based on the kit's model, cache and prefill accounting; additional streams remain subject to engine admission. Physical execution is unmeasured here.
title: Qwen3.8 Flash Next INT4-AUTOROUND TensorFold dual Spark (Mia)
